d: An inanimate, sentient object consisting of a tan wide-brimmed hat perched atop a dark teal-colored cloak with a blue and teal plaid lining. The object is supported by a black mechanical frame featuring a small gold-colored wheel at the base and is adorned with a brown leather saddle, a teal braided rope, and a gold-colored metallic badge pinned to the hat. The ensemble is completed by a brown leather belt with a red and white striped accent circling the crown of the hat. BODY COLOR: dark teal and tan.
